build_commands.buildah_with_export: buildah build -t tiledb-vector-search:latest -f /artifacts/environment/Dockerfile.final /artifacts/environment && buildah push tiledb-vector-search:latest oci-archive:/artifacts/environment/openenv_validation_oci.tar

build_steps.command: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl python3.11-venv python3.11-dev libopenblas-dev build-essential cmake

build_steps.description: Copy and execute repo_setup.sh to materialize /workspace
Copy and execute setup_runtime.sh to create Python venv and install dependencies

verification.test_command: cd apis/python && pytest test/test_distance_metrics.py -s -k "test_cosine_distance or test_inner_product_distances or test_ivf_flat_cosine_simple or test_ivf_flat_ingestion_cosine"

notes: eval.sh and test.patch are runtime-mounted verifier assets, not baked into the image. The image is ready for RL agent use with WORKDIR /workspace.
